Let me check how frontend gets user ID - likely an x-user-id header injected by oauth2-proxy or by the frontend. Let me check oauth2-proxy config. The guide says login user is created in Keycloak. The identity management service resolves the user. Note GET /projects returned 200 [] with no auth issue (probably because oauth2-proxy injects headers). For POST, it says "Could not get user ID from headers or request body" - so it needs `createdById` or a specific header. Let me pass createdById.

Actually the frontend probably passes createdById. Let me retry with createdById = LOCAL_USER_ID. But that may conflict if identity not synced. Let's try.
